encounters.notes: Mycelia Floor: Nestlings steal Shared orbs and drop feather maps.
Wisps restore plates to the nestlings every 6 s; break the healers first.
Mercy puzzle: the egg never attacks; shatter it for Sunlight x3 or leave it Broken to hatch later (+Light).
Mid-City: FAILED ink slows the floor while the acolyte mends plates in moonlight.
A charger that snaps trees into cover, flanked by cloaking raptors.
Canopy: the Crown Saurian is untouchable until a Tether snap drags it down.
Three bodies sharing damage across a living tether; burning Shared too fast triggers the Fake Carrier Burn.
The pupa never attacks unless attacked; killing it unprovoked is +10 Dark and closes the Golden Light ending.
